title: Recommendation Systems Engineer
description: Architect large-scale personalization engines, collaborative filtering algorithms, two-tower embedding models, and real-time reranking systems.

goal.objective: Engineer high-impact personalization algorithms that drive user engagement, conversions, and retention across millions of global users.

learn.summary: Master collaborative filtering, matrix factorization, Two-Tower neural architectures (User/Item embeddings), vector search at scale (FAISS/Milvus), and real-time multi-objective ranking.

capstone_projects.title: Two-Stage Real-Time E-Commerce Recommendation Engine
capstone_projects.description: Architect a candidate generation and deep ranking pipeline using two-tower vector embeddings and approximate nearest neighbors (ANN) for sub-30ms serving.

capstone_projects.title: Contextual Multi-Armed Bandit & Collaborative Filtering Pipeline
capstone_projects.description: Build an exploration-exploitation recommendation service using Upper Confidence Bound (UCB) bandits and matrix factorization to overcome cold-start dilemmas.

Loss Functions in Recommendation (BPR Loss, Triplet Loss, Cross-Entropy with Negative Sampling)
Offline vs Online Evaluation (NDCG, MAP@K, Hit Rate vs Click-Through Rate, A/B Testing)

tree.name: Fundamentals of Recommendation Systems
tree.description: Master recommendation system architecture: Candidate retrieval, ranking, re-ranking, offline metrics vs online business metrics, and feedback loops.

children.name: Introduction and Core Concepts
children.description: Understand core recommender paradigms: Explicit vs implicit feedback, click-through rate (CTR), conversion rate (CVR), watch time optimization, and feedback loop polarization.

children.name: Data for Recommendation Systems
children.description: Engineer data pipelines for recommendations: User interaction logs, item catalogs, user demographic attributes, context features (timestamp, device), and handling extreme data sparsity.

resources.title: LLM Course – Build a Semantic Book Recommender (Python, OpenAI, LangChain, Gradio) (freeCodeCamp.org)

children.name: Evaluation Metrics and A/B Testing Basics
children.description: Evaluate recommender systems offline and online: Precision@K, Recall@K, Mean Average Precision (MAP@K), Normalized Discounted Cumulative Gain (NDCG@K), Hit Rate, and A/B test statistical significance.

resources.title: Recommender System Evaluation - Towards Data Science

tree.name: Traditional Recommendation Algorithms
tree.description: Implement classical baseline algorithms: Heuristics, collaborative filtering, matrix factorization, and content-based feature filtering.

resources.title: Chapter 2: Classic Recommender Systems - Recommender Systems Handbook

children.name: Non-Personalized & Heuristic Baselines
children.description: Build non-personalized baselines: Popularity-based ranking, recency-weighted trending items, association rule mining (Apriori), and co-occurrence frequency matrices.

resources.title: LLM Course – Build a Semantic Book Recommender (Python, OpenAI, LangChain, Gradio) (freeCodeCamp.org)

children.name: Collaborative Filtering (CF)
children.description: Implement memory-based collaborative filtering: User-based and item-based collaborative filtering, cosine similarity, Pearson correlation, and k-nearest neighbors (KNN) on sparse interaction matrices.

children.name: Matrix Factorization Techniques
children.description: Factorize large interaction matrices: Singular Value Decomposition (SVD), Alternating Least Squares (ALS) with implicit feedback, Probabilistic Matrix Factorization (PMF), and Bayesian Personalized Ranking (BPR).

resources.title: Matrix Factorization for Recommender Systems - Medium

children.name: Content-Based Recommendation
children.description: Build content-based recommendation engines: TF-IDF item representations, metadata feature matching, BERT/text embedding similarity, and constructing user preference profiles.

LLM Course – Build a Semantic Book Recommender (Python, OpenAI, LangChain, Gradio) (freeCodeCamp.org)

children.name: Hybrid Recommender Systems
children.description: Design hybrid recommender systems: Combining collaborative filtering predictions with content-based features using weighted ensembles, cascading filters, or feature stacking.

resources.title: Hybrid Recommender Systems: A Survey - ResearchGate

tree.name: Deep Learning for Recommendation Systems
tree.description: Architect modern deep learning recommendation models: Two-tower retrieval, feature interaction networks, and sequential session modeling.

resources.title: Deep Learning for Recommender Systems (DLRS) Tutorial

children.name: Embeddings for RecSys
children.description: Generate high-capacity entity embeddings: Word2Vec-style Item2Vec on user session trajectories, Graph Convolutional Networks (PinSage, LightGCN), and multimodal item embeddings.
